description: Start a homeowners or landlord insurance quote for a property in California. Collect every field from the user first. Ask for the date of birth as typed text, not with a date picker: picking a birth year decades back in a calendar is hard. Before calling, tell the user that DwellQuote and its partner agency Somerset Agency will use these details to request quotes from insurance carriers. Returns a quote_id for the other DwellQuote tools; next, call get_property_details.

address.description: Full property address: street, city, state and ZIP code

date_of_birth.description: Collect as typed text (for example 04/02/1980), never with a date picker or calendar, then send it as YYYY-MM-DD. The applicant must be 18 or older.

email.description: Used to verify the user when they finish on dwellquote.com

name: start_quote
title: Start a home insurance quote
